top_categories.workout_context: Cappadocia Gran Fondo's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Cappadocia Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before race day.
At Cappadocia Gran Fondo, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Cappadocia Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.
Cappadocia Gran Fondo's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 67 miles.
67 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Base fitness for Cappadocia Gran Fondo. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Cappadocia Gran Fondo, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Cappadocia Gran Fondo’s 67 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Cappadocia Gran Fondo. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, VO2max, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 67 miles of mixed terrain in Uçhisar, Cappadocia, Turkey (historical course; current Büyük Sürüş ride is Ürgüp-based).
